english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for a person or situation free from blame, including legal innocence; a specifically legal verdict is more exactly 無罪.

examples.english: He is innocent, so stop blaming him.
examples.traditional: 佢係無辜嘅，唔好再怪佢。
